Exercise figures — review draft

Draft · not clinically reviewed

Deterministic schematics of each item's written movement, start and end positions side by side.

ex-neck-01 · Chin tuck

Glide your chin straight back, as if making a double chin.

tracks head · Person sitting tall, gliding the chin straight back with eyes level.

str-neck-01 · Chin-to-chest stretch

Slowly lower your chin toward your chest until you feel a gentle stretch at the back of the neck.

tracks head · Person sitting tall, head bowed forward with chin toward the chest.

ex-neck-02 · Look-up practice

Keeping the chin tucked, slowly tip your head back to look up at the ceiling.

tracks head · Person sitting tall with chin tucked, head tipped back to look upward.

ex-shoulder-01 · Pendulum swing

Gently sway your body so the hanging arm swings forward and back like a pendulum.

tracks hand · Person leaning on a table, sore arm hanging and swinging gently forward and back.

ex-shoulder-02 · Arm raise forward

Slowly raise the sore arm forward and up, as high as stays comfortable.

tracks hand · Person standing, raising one arm forward and upward with thumb leading.

ex-shoulder-03 · Hands behind the back

Slowly move the sore hand behind your back, as if reaching for a back pocket.

tracks hand · Person standing upright, one hand reaching behind the back.

ex-elbow-01 · Elbow bend

Slowly bend the elbow, bringing your hand up toward your shoulder.

tracks hand · Person standing, bending one elbow to bring the hand toward the shoulder.

ex-elbow-02 · Elbow straightening

Slowly straighten the elbow, pushing the hand down toward the floor.

tracks hand · Person standing, straightening a bent elbow to push the hand downward.

str-elbow-01 · Overhead triceps stretch

With the other hand, gently press the bent elbow further down behind your head.

tracks hand · Person standing with one arm overhead and bent, hand resting behind the head.

str-wrist-01 · Wrist bend stretch

With the other hand, gently press the back of the sore hand downward until you feel a stretch at the wrist.

tracks hand · Person holding one arm out, pressing the back of that hand downward.

str-wrist-02 · Wrist extension stretch

With the other hand, gently press the fingers back and down until you feel a stretch in the wrist and forearm.

tracks hand · Person holding one arm out palm up, pressing the fingers gently backward.

ex-lowerback-01 · Standing pelvic tilt

Gently flatten your lower back into the wall by tightening your stomach muscles.

tracks head · Person standing against a wall, flattening the lower back into it.

ex-lowerback-02 · Standing back extension

Slowly arch backward over your hands, looking slightly upward.

tracks head · Person standing with hands on the lower back, arching gently backward.

ex-lowerback-03 · Hip hinge practice

Push your hips straight back and slide your hands down your thighs, keeping your back flat.

tracks head · Person standing, pushing hips back with a flat back, hands sliding down the thighs.

ex-hip-01 · Mini squat

Bend your knees and sit back a little, as if starting to sit down.

tracks head · Person holding a chair, knees bent in a shallow squat with chest up.

ex-hip-02 · Sit-to-stand practice

Lean your chest forward over your knees, then push up to standing.

tracks head · Person rising from a chair, chest forward over the knees.

ex-hip-03 · Gentle marching

Slowly lift one knee toward hip height, then place it back down. Alternate legs.

tracks foot · Person holding a chair, lifting one knee toward hip height.

str-knee-01 · Standing quadriceps stretch

Gently pull the heel toward your buttock until you feel a stretch down the front of the thigh.

tracks foot · Person holding a chair, one foot pulled up behind toward the buttock.

str-knee-02 · Hamstring stretch

Keeping your back straight, lean gently forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.

tracks foot · Person with one heel on a low step, leaning gently forward with a straight back.

ex-ankle-01 · Ankle pumps

Slowly point your toes away from you, then pull them back toward your shin.

tracks foot · Person seated, foot pointing away then pulling back toward the shin.

ex-ankle-02 · Toe raises

Keeping your heels down, slowly lift the front of both feet off the floor.

tracks foot · Person holding a chair, lifting the fronts of the feet while heels stay down.

Important notice — read before exercising
